outcome: modes of home storage of opioids
amount of opioids taken relative to the amount prescribed
reasons for not taking all prescribed medications
storage and disposal methods for leftover opioids
cohort: Adult patients who had C-section or thoracic surgery at a tertiary academic medical center
finding: Current opioid prescribing practices for pain management at hospital discharge following Cesarean section and thoracic surgery may not account for individual patients' analgesic requirements, leading to excess opioid pills commonly stored in unsecured locations.
